blocks.text:
LIST OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTER SHOWN - IN
AT 10.45 A.M. ON MONDAY, 14 JANUARY, 1980,
IN THE RACEWAY AND BHAVAN.

blocks.html:
1.Sarbatti Indira Gandhi... Prime Minister/All Ministries/Departments not specified below.
2.Rao Brendra Singh... Minister of Agriculture.
3.Shri R. Shankaranand... Minister of Education.
4.Shri A. B. A. Ghani Khan Chaudhary... Minister of Energy and Irrigation
5.Shri P. V. Narasimha Rao... Minister of External Affairs
6.Shri J. Venkataraman... Minister of Finance.
7.Shri V. P. Sutha... Minister of Information and Broadcasting.
8.Giani Zaili Singh... Minister of Home Affairs
9.Shri Shiv Shankar... Minister of Law, Justice and Company Affairs.
10.Shri Dhanipati Tripathi... Minister of Railways
11.Shri A. P. Sharma... Minister of Shipping and Transport
12.Shri J. D. Patnaik... Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation.
13.Shri P. G. Sethi... Minister of Works and Housing
14.Shri Dheshwar Narain Singh... Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.
15.Shri Pranab Mukherjee... Minister of Commerce.

1.Shri R. V. Swaminathan... Minister of State in the Ministry of Agriculture.
2.Shri Jagannath Janadia... Minister of State in the Ministry of Finance.
3.Shri Nihar Ranjan Laskar... Minister of State in the Ministry of Health.
4.Shri P. Venkataraman... Minister of State in the Ministry of Affairs.
5.Shri Yogendra Makwana... Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs.
6.Shri G. K. Jaffer Sharief... Minister of State in the Ministry of Railways.
7.Shri Kartik Orach... Minister of State in the Ministry of Tourism and Civil Aviation.
